steps.en: The notice is already temporarily suspended
A work item with both addresses and their dates is created
steps.id: Work item berisi kedua alamat dan tanggalnya dibuat
steps.why_en: This is not built; the second address is not even kept after the system chooses.
steps.why_id: Belum dibangun; alamat kedua bahkan tidak disimpan setelah sistem memilih.

steps.en: The work item appears on the OIC's dashboard
steps.id: Work item muncul di dashboard OIC
steps.why_en: There is no work item page or dashboard entry for the officer.
steps.why_id: Belum ada halaman work item atau entri dashboard untuk officer.

steps.en: The OIC reviews both addresses and picks the letter address
steps.id: OIC meninjau kedua alamat dan memilih alamat surat
steps.why_en: The officer cannot see the second address anywhere, so there is nothing to decide between.
steps.why_id: Officer tidak bisa melihat alamat kedua di mana pun, jadi tidak ada yang bisa dipilih.
